The empty-criteria regression should be fixed because it marks requirements without evidence as proven. This review read both changed files and all available tests; no tests were run.

## Changes
The pull request changes how requirement proof status is calculated and adds a helper that checks whether every entry in a nonempty batch is reviewed.

Both `sum(...)` and `len(criteria)` evaluate to zero, so removing `bool(criteria)` changes the empty-input result. — Requirements with no criteria can be incorrectly reported as proven.
